seychelles.title: Flag of the Republic of Seychelles

colors.note: Represents the sky and the sea that surrounds the archipelago.
Symbolises the sun that lights and warms the islands.
Represents the people and their determination to work together in unity and love.
Represents the land and the natural environment.

desc:
- Five oblique bands of blue, yellow, red, white, and green radiating from the lower hoist corner
- The bands fan out like rays, suggesting a young country moving into a dynamic new future
- Adopted on 18 June 1996, replacing an earlier post-1977 socialist-era design

countryData.name: Seychelles
countryData.location: Indian Ocean, east of mainland Africa

trivia:
- The radiating stripe pattern is nearly unique among national flags
- Blue and yellow come from the ruling Seychelles People's Progressive Front, red and white from the former opposition
- Seychelles has had four different flags since gaining independence from the UK in 1976
- The design symbolises a dynamic young country moving into the future
